text:
deploy-bot: Started traffic ramp for service/model-serving v3.2.1 -> staged plan: 0% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 30m.
Maya: Ramp seems stuck at 20% after ~5m, see a lot of 429s from the mesh sidecars.
Tom: Confirmed, envoy logs showing repeated 429 ratelimit responses. Any recent mesh policy changes?
Maya: Helm values for the rollout look correct: `split: { primary: 80, candidate: 20 }`. But mesh global limit is `max_rate: 250rps` per namespace — candidate warmup is blowing past that.
Chris: We put that global cap in last week to control egress cost. Did the rollout controller expect unlimited mesh throughput?
Maya: Looks like the canary controller applied weights but due to mesh RL the candidate never got traffic. Automated rollback didn't fire because `p95_latency` stayed within thresholds — metrics delayed.
Tom: Can you paste the envoy error snippet?
Maya: Sure: 
```
[2026-03-12T10:03:21Z] ratelimit: deny, descriptors: ["service:model-serving", "namespace:prod"], returned 429
```
Tom: That matches. We should either increase mesh quota or exempt candidate pods from the global rate limiter during rollout.
Infra-bot: Suggestion: set `rollout.strategy.pause: true`, add `canary.annotations: mesh.ratelimit=false` or bump `mesh.rateLimit` temporarily.
Maya: Tried a manual patch to speed setWeight: `kubectl patch rollout model-serving -p '{"spec":{"strategy":{"canary":{"steps":[{"setWeight":50}]}}}}'` but envoy still 429ing.
Tom: Also spotted terraform drift: `module.mesh.aws_appmesh_route_service` is missing an updated `retry_policy` that we pushed last month — route behavior might not match current mesh expectations. Opening TF PR.
Chris: Cost note: increasing global mesh quota affects egress cost caps. We need finance signoff for anything >20% bump.
Maya: Proposed mitigation plan: 1) Pause rollout, 2) Temporarily increase mesh quota for 20m, 3) Apply TF fix for route config, 4) Resume with smaller steps (10% increments) and backoff, 5) Add envoy 429 SLI into rollout controller so throttling triggers a safe rollback in future.
Tom: I'll change the canary steps in the Helm chart to 10% per step + 5m wait and add retries. Pushing PR now.
Maya: Pushed overlay to disable local mesh RL on candidate pods for testing -> PR #4123.
Infra-bot: Reminder: quota bump requires approval from @Finance for windows >20% (cost risk).
Chris: @Finance can you approve a temporary 30% bump limited to 20 minutes? We'll monitor and revert automatically.
Finance: Approved for a 20-minute window, please provide exact start/end timestamps in the PR.
Maya: Quota bumped at 10:25 UTC, watching metrics. Envoy 429s decreasing, candidate traffic moving 20% -> 40%.
Tom: :thumbsup: resuming staged rollout with 10% increments and 5m waits, instrumenting envoy 429s.
deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 40% -> 60% -> 80% -> 100%. Finalizing and marking rollout complete.
Maya: :white_check_mark: Closing thread. Will file a short postmortem focusing on TF drift + making rollouts mesh-aware (and wiring envoy 429 as a rollback signal).
